name: @ylcnfrht/enhanced-abort-controller
description: AbortController with .NET CancellationTokenSource powers: resettable abortAfter, disposable register(), whenAborted, linked controllers that clean up, TimeSpan. The signal is a real AbortSignal, so fetch and every AbortSignal API accept it. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')"
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && node test/dist/smoke.mjs && node test/dist/smoke.cjs && node examples/4-commonjs.cjs | grep -q 'aborted: timed out' && echo 'dist ok'
scripts.check:package: npm run build && npx -y publint --strict && npx -y @arethetypeswrong/cli --pack .
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:dist
